2610.05816.title: Level-of-Token Diffusion
2610.05816.paper_summary: Image and video diffusion models allocate equal computation to every region, even when the intended scene calls for varying levels of detail. The spatial distribution of detail can often be anticipated before generation, indicating where computation can be reduced. We introduce Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion, a framework that turns this knowledge into an explicit multiresolution token layout (Level-of-Token layout) for adaptive and efficient generation. Tokens represent rectangular patches of varying sizes and shapes, allocating finer tokens where detail is needed and coarser tokens elsewhere. We adapt pretrained diffusion transformers to LoT layouts through a patch-wise asymmetric flow parametrization and embeddings for multiresolution tokens, preserving full-resolution flow prediction at every denoising step while processing only a reduced token sequence. LoT Diffusion enables layout-adaptive generation while preserving pretrained generative priors. We demonstrate LoT with layouts derived from semantic masks, bounding boxes, texture variance, and depth-of-field cues, as well as agentic plans. Across image and video generation, LoT offers favorable quality-efficiency tradeoffs, with significant speedups determined by the layout's token budget. Our project website is at https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/.
2610.05816.paper_summary_zh: 影像和視頻擴散模型對每個區域分配相等的計算，即使預期場景需要不同程度的細節。細節的空間分佈在生成之前通常可以預測，這表明可以在哪裡減少計算。我們介紹了基於標記層級（Level-of-Token, LoT）擴散的框架，將這一知識轉化為明確的多解析度標記佈局（標記層級佈局），以實現自適應和高效的生成。標記代表不同大小和形狀的矩形區塊，在需要細節的地方分配更細的標記，而在其他地方則使用較粗的標記。我們通過補丁級不對稱流參數化和多解析度標記的嵌入，將預訓練的擴散Transformer適應於LoT佈局，在每個去噪步驟中保留全解析度流預測，同時僅處理減少的標記序列。LoT擴散使得佈局自適應生成成為可能，同時保留預訓練的生成先驗。我們展示了基於語義掩模、邊界框、紋理變異和景深提示以及代理計劃的佈局的LoT。在影像和視頻生成中，LoT提供了有利的質量效率權衡，佈局的標記預算決定了顯著的加速。我們的項目網站位於 https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/。
